mechanism: Sertraline inhibits reuptake of serotonin while amphetamine increases serotonergic and catecholaminergic activity, creating risk for serotonin syndrome; amphetamine also increases cardiac stimulation and may potentiate CNS effects.
action: Use combination only when clinically necessary with careful monitoring for serotonin syndrome symptoms, hypertension, tachycardia, and psychiatric destabilization; consider alternative ADHD medications.
